appDesc.message: Download media from Cobalt-supported sites via the official API. Configure your instance and download via click, context menu or popup.

sessionNone.message: No session — if the instance is protected, set Api-Key/JWT in options (⚙)

errConfigure.message: Configure the instance in options (⚙) first. See instances.cobalt.best for community instances, or host your own.

dlFailed.message: Download failed ($1). Try the direct link or download again.

errBadJson.message: The instance returned invalid JSON (HTTP $1). Try another instance.

errNet.message: Network/CORS failure: $1. Check the instance URL and whether it allows access (Api-Key/JWT).

testUnexpected.message: Unexpected response (HTTP $1). Is this a current Cobalt instance?

feHtml.message: The instance returned HTML$1 instead of JSON. You entered the website/frontend URL (e.g. cobalt.meowing.de), not the API URL. The web frontend is not the API: set the API base URL (your own instance or a permitted community API — see instances.cobalt.best). Also prefer https:// over http://.

errAuthApiKey.message: This instance requires an Api-Key. Enter it in options.

errAuthBearer.message: This instance requires authentication. Set an Api-Key or JWT token in options.

errAuthJwt.message: Session missing/expired. Paste a valid Api-Key or JWT token in options.

errAuthTurnstile.message: This instance requires authentication. Set an Api-Key or JWT token in options.

errAuthInvalid.message: Invalid key/token. Check the Api-Key or paste a new JWT token.

errAuthRatelimit.message: Instance rate limit exceeded. Wait and try again.

errLinkInvalid.message: Invalid link or one not supported by this instance.

errServiceUnsupported.message: Service not supported by this instance.

errFetchFail.message: The instance could not read the link (removed content, anti-bot block, or service login required).

errFetchEmpty.message: No public media at this link (removed, private, region-restricted, or login required).

errFetchCritical.message: Extraction failed — the service usually requires login. Try another link or set up cookies.json on the instance.

errRateExceeded.message: Instance limit exceeded. Wait ~1 min and try again (avoid parallel bursts).

errNativeMissing.message: Native host not installed. Run native-host/install-host.sh from the extension folder.

errLocalDownFull.message: Local instance unavailable: $1 (docker daemon running? container created via install-host.sh?)

notifNoInstanceM.message: Open the popup or options and enter the instance URL (your own instance or one from instances.cobalt.best).

notifFrontendT.message: Cobalt: frontend URL, not the API

notifFrontendM.message: The configured URL returned the website (HTML). Enter the API base URL, not the web frontend. Use https://.

notifFailM.message: $1 — failed ($2). Click to open the direct link.

optLocalUse.message: Local instance selected. Save (or already applies to the popup).

optWarn.message:
The public api.cobalt.tools instance uses anti-bot protection and is not open to third parties (see API docs). Host your own instance (guide) or use a community instance from instances.cobalt.best (with the owner's permission) — paste the base URL below, e.g. https://cobalt.your-instance.example.
Important: use the API URL, not the website/frontend URL (cobalt.meowing.de is just the site — it returns HTML and causes JSON errors). Always use https://; http:// usually returns just an HTML redirect.

optApiKeyHint.message: Sent as the Authorization: Api-Key <key> header. Leave blank if the instance is open.

optLocalHint.message: Starts your own API at http://localhost:9000 when Firefox opens and stops it when you close Firefox (immediate stop + host supervisor that shuts down after ~6 min without signal — also covers crash and suspend). No cost when closed. Requires: running docker daemon and native-host/install-host.sh run once.

optLocalAuto.message: Start with Firefox and stop on close (recommended)

optAntibotHint.message: Your instance already runs with a YouTube session generator (automatic poToken). For the rest, the official mechanism is cookies from your own session (Cobalt only accesses what you already access logged in — nothing is bypassed):

optAntibotList.message:
• YouTube: automatic poToken + cookies (if it still fails)
  • Instagram: sessionid · Reddit: OAuth triple · Twitter/X: auth_token+ct0 · Vimeo: access_token
  • TikTok: out of scope (right-clicking the video already works) · VK/OK/Snapchat/Bilibili: no mechanism supported by Cobalt

optCookiesGuide.message: How to export: install Get cookies.txt LOCALLY, export while logged into the service, and build ~/cobalt-local/cookies.json following ~/cobalt-local/cookies.example.json (only the cookies listed per service). File permission 600. Then click Restart above.

optSessionGuideLead.message: Protected instances (e.g. https://cobalt-api.meowing.de) require authentication. Supported paths (the Turnstile challenge cannot run inside extensions — AMO policy forbids remote code and Cloudflare only accepts the site's own domain):

optSessionGuide.message:
• Api-Key: ask the instance owner and paste it in the field above (takes precedence);
  • Manual JWT token: if the owner provides a Bearer token, paste it below — the extension sends it as Authorization: Bearer … until it expires;
  • Own/local instance: no authentication (recommended).

optJwtHint.message: Validity is read from the token itself and shown below.

optProtected.message: Protected: set Api-Key or manual JWT.

optNotFrontend.message: Frontend/website URL, not the API (returned HTML).

errUnsafeUrl.message: Unsafe URL blocked (the instance returned an unexpected protocol).

stLocalProcessing.message: This instance requires local processing (tunnels). Opening list…
